messages.subject: Invoice question - cement mixer trailer
messages.body:
Hello,

We received the invoice for the cement mixer trailer rental and wanted to check a couple of things. Could you send us a detailed breakdown?

Best regards,
Routakallion Infra Oy

messages.subject: Re: Invoice question - cement mixer trailer
messages.body:
Understood. I'll check the invoice and send you a breakdown.

Marko Seppälä
Branch Manager

messages.subject: Re: Invoice question - cement mixer trailer
messages.body: Do you have a 20kVA diesel generator available? We need one for a site in Rovaniemi, would need it fairly soon.

messages.subject: Re: Invoice question - cement mixer trailer
messages.body:
We're finished with the 20kVA generator. Can we arrange the return? Happy to bring it to the Rovaniemi depot or you can collect from site, whichever suits.

Routakallion Infra Oy
